title: Schedule: Cycle Window for Recounting Cancellation-Rate Warnings, by Wayfare Driver Level
content:
Under the **Driver Services Agreements and Account Standing** product, a recount of the cancellation warning sequence number (the number a cancellation-rate warning carries within the driver's current warning cycle) reaches back over a cycle window set by the agreement's service level.

**Cycle-window rule.** A recount of the cancellation warning sequence number counts the earlier cancellation-rate warnings dated fewer than 24 whole calendar months before the recording day on the Wayfare Black and Wayfare Black SUV levels, fewer than 18 months on the Wayfare Comfort and Wayfare XL levels, and fewer than 12 months on the Wayfare Standard and Wayfare Green levels.

| Service level of the agreement | Cycle window (earlier cancellation-rate warnings dated fewer than this many whole calendar months before the recording day) |
|---|---|
| Wayfare Standard | 12 |
| Wayfare Green | 12 |
| Wayfare Comfort | 18 |
| Wayfare XL | 18 |
| Wayfare Black | 24 |
| Wayfare Black SUV | 24 |

**Notes.**
1. Only cancellation-rate warnings are counted; rating warnings are not.
2. A warning dated exactly the window's number of whole calendar months before the recording day, or more, falls outside the cycle window.

**Hypothetical reading.** Recording day 2026-09-15, earlier cancellation-rate warnings dated 2024-10-01, 2025-06-10 and 2026-02-02. On Wayfare Black (24 months) all three fall inside the cycle window. On Wayfare XL (18 months) the two from 2025 and 2026 do. On Wayfare Green (12 months) only the warning of 2026-02-02 does.
